# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Expect tighter supply and higher prices; lock in key high‑risk parts now.

## What changed
- Market supply risk holds at 71.8 (↑0.2) and price trend at 82.0 (↓0.2), still “Elevated” and “Rising” respectively[1].  
- TSMC foundry loading up 56 % YoY through Oct 2026, pushing supply tighter[3].  
- Korea chip‑led exports jumped 100 % YoY in early Nov 2026, reinforcing both supply pressure and price rise[4].  
- Semiconductor PPI surged +9.1 % annualized over the last three months, feeding higher prices[1].  
- Global chip sales hit $172.6 B in Sep 2026, +148.3 % YoY, adding demand‑side stress[2].

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time 14 weeks, stock 27,081 units, no on‑order quantity or arrival data.  
- Price $5.56 / unit (qty 1) vs $2.51 / unit (1 k).  
- Origin Austria, tariff 0 % (no surcharge).  
- Supply risk 54 (Neutral), price trend 67.9 (Rising).  
- Buy‑timing call: **Hold course** – 59 % chance of price rise, no strong timing signal[10].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – Elevated (71.8 ↑0.1), Rising (79.5) – High confidence.  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – Elevated (70.3 ↑0.4), Rising (74.1) – High confidence.  
- Analog & power management – Rising (69.4 ↑0.2), Rising (76.7) – High confidence.  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – Rising (67.1 ↑0.3), Rising (76.4) – High confidence.  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – Rising (66.5 ↑0.3), Rising (79.6) – High confidence.

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – Severe supply risk 86.1, 52‑week lead time vs 12‑week norm.  
- **SN65HVD230DR** – Elevated risk 82.3, 26‑week lead time.  
- **LM358DR** – Elevated risk 82.0, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TPS62130RGTR** – Elevated risk 81.7, 26‑week lead time.  
- **TLV9002IDR** – Elevated risk 81.2, 26‑week lead time.

## Outlook
- Chip prices next 3 mo: 66 % chance of rise, expected +2.17 % (80 % range ‑9.57 % to +13.91 %), model‑tested edge.  
- Chip prices next 6 mo: 52 % chance of rise, expected +4.34 % (‑8.79 % to +17.46 %), trend‑following baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 3 mo: 63 % chance of tighter supply, expected +1.82 pts (‑1.71 to +5.36 pts), baseline.  
- Fab utilization next 6 mo: 60 % chance of tighter supply, expected +3.64 pts (‑2.16 to +9.45 pts), baseline.  

## Negotiation angle
- **Lock pricing** on the top‑risk parts (10M08SAE144C8G, SN65HVD230DR, LM358DR, TPS62130RGTR, TLV9002IDR) before lead‑time spikes widen further.  
- **Push for volume discounts** on the featured part IPB017N10N5ATMA1, citing its neutral supply risk but rising price trend.  
- **Ask suppliers for updated on‑order visibility** (PBO) and any potential tariff changes for Austria‑origin MOSFETs to refine timing decisions.
